title: Digi FX Control
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: The DIGI FX page on the master page tree (FUNC+LFO), as the fourth entry: enable and tune EQ (on, low, high), RING (on, depth, frequency), FOLD (on, amount) and the level meter. Encoders A-H edit one parameter each (OS-style step acceleration); the L/R meter is drawn here. It drives digieq / digiring / digifold / digimeter (all required).
